title: Naturally Smoky Venezuelan Chicken Skewers
description: A floral and molten Venezuelan dish featuring mayonnaise and tempering chocolate, served on a cedar plank, this recipe is FODMAP friendly and perfect for a dinner meal.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, tempering chocolate, smoked paprika, garlic free seasoning, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken breast pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the mayonnaise mixture.
Thread the chicken pieces onto the soaked cedar planks, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the cedar planks on the grill and cook for 10 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the chicken skewers hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
